title: Make a guest locale default reversible
goal: Distinguish per-command settings from a new guest login default; apply and restore one documented locale policy.
challenge: Correct one prepared default/category inconsistency and prove new-session versus existing-shell behavior. Retain actual outputs/statuses and preserve originals; report reasoning through self-review, not a score.

steps.command: w=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/foundation-locale-persistence.XXXXXX") && cd "$w" && umask 077; here() { case "$w" in "$HOME"/foundation-locale-persistence.??????) ;; *) return 19;; esac; test "${w%/*}" = "$HOME" && test -d "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && test "$(realpath -e "$w")" = "$w" && test "$(pwd -P)" = "$w" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a "$w")" = learner:700; }; fresh() { here && test "${1%/*}" = "$w" && test ! -e "$1" && test ! -L "$1"; }; regular() { here && test "${1%/*}" = "$w" && test -f "$1" && test ! -L "$1" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h "$1")" = learner:600:1; }; here && test "$(df -B1 --output=avail / | tail -1)" -ge 1073741824 && pwd
steps.explanation: Record this unique guest-only workspace. On Resume re-establish the recorded path/definitions; never overwrite another exercise.
steps.expected: Private learner-owned700 directory and observed1GiB free admission.

steps.command: foundation_step() { here && fresh "$w/locale-before.sha" && fresh "$w/shell-before.txt" && test "$(readlink /etc/default/locale)" = ../locale.conf && test -f /etc/locale.conf && test ! -L /etc/locale.conf && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a:%h /etc/locale.conf)" = root:root:644:1 || return 19; rw=$(sudo mktemp -d /var/tmp/ll-locale.XXXXXX) || return 19; case "$rw" in /var/tmp/ll-locale.??????) ;; *) return 19;; esac; sudo test ! -e "$rw/before" && sudo test ! -L "$rw/before" && sudo cp -p /etc/locale.conf "$rw/before" && sudo sha256sum "$rw/before" > "$w/snapshot-before.sha" && sha256sum /etc/locale.conf > locale-before.sha && locale > shell-before.txt && printf "Recorded workspace: %s\nRoot snapshot: %s\n" "$w" "$rw"; }; foundation_step
steps.explanation: Write down both exact paths for the fresh login. Preserve the resolved regular target, not an accidentally replaced /etc/default/locale symlink.
steps.expected: Root-only original snapshot and unchanged parent environment.

steps.command: here && fresh "$w/locale-change.sha" && fresh "$w/shell-after.txt" && sha256sum -c locale-before.sha && test "$(readlink /etc/default/locale)" = ../locale.conf && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a:%h /etc/locale.conf)" = root:root:644:1 && sudo /usr/sbin/update-locale --reset LANG=de_DE.UTF-8 && sha256sum /etc/locale.conf > locale-change.sha && grep -Fx LANG=de_DE.UTF-8 /etc/locale.conf && locale > shell-after.txt && cmp shell-before.txt shell-after.txt
steps.explanation: Change only the approved guest locale default. update-locale writes an unquoted LANG line; this does not modify the already-running shell.
steps.expected: Changed default bytes, unchanged current shell.

steps.explanation: Log out of only the learner guest console. Getty logs learner in again automatically; this is a new login, not a password/PAM change. Re-enter the recorded w/rw paths and here/fresh/regular definitions before continuing.
steps.expected: Fresh console login, LANG=de_DE.UTF-8 and LC_ALL unset.

steps.command: foundation_step() { case "$rw" in /var/tmp/ll-locale.??????) ;; *) return 19;; esac; test "$(sudo realpath -e "$rw")" = "$rw" && test "$(sudo stat -c %U:%G:%a "$rw")" = root:root:700 && sudo sha256sum -c "$w/snapshot-before.sha" && here && test "$LANG" = de_DE.UTF-8 && test -z "${LC_ALL-}" && test "$(date -d "2026-01-01 UTC" +%A)" = Donnerstag && sha256sum -c locale-change.sha && test "$(readlink /etc/default/locale)" = ../locale.conf && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a:%h /etc/locale.conf)" = root:root:644:1 && sudo test -f "$rw/before" && sudo test ! -L "$rw/before" && test "$(sudo stat -c %U:%G:%a:%h "$rw/before")" = root:root:644:1 || return 19; sudo cp -- "$rw/before" /etc/locale.conf && sha256sum -c locale-before.sha && test "$(readlink /etc/default/locale)" = ../locale.conf; }; foundation_step
steps.explanation: Verify actual new-login values before byte-exact rollback. Refuse unexpected target/snapshot changes. Exit once more to observe the original default; retained paths remain evidence.
steps.expected: Original bytes/mode/link restored; a later login uses original locale.

hints: Editing LANG in the current shell is not persistent; LC_ALL can conceal the changed default.
Choose command scope deliberately; compare known bytes and actual statuses, not only a successful-looking display.
Retain before evidence; refuse collisions and restore exact policy state before leaving. Guest root can bypass guest-side guards.
review: I demonstrated the selected mode’s actual observations and retained an incorrect or incomplete case.
I preserved originals and can explain the reasoning and limitations; this records self-review, not automatic assessment.
I restored any changed default/zone and retained the exact workspace without touching unrelated files.
